title: feat(2d): arc turns and their radius on Face, 2D Contour and Slot
body:
## What changed

Face, 2D Contour and Slot have the arc turns option with a corner arc radius. The parameters are `blend_turns` and `blend_radius`, the same as on 2D Pocket, 2D Adaptive and 2D Offset (#1733).

All three kinds can round their corners safely. No kind is left out.

- **2D Contour** had `blend_turns`. It gets `blend_radius`. No radius is the tool radius, as before.
- **Face** had `blend_turns`. It gets `blend_radius`. No radius is the semicircle of half the row spacing, as before. A smaller radius gives two quarter arcs with a straight step between them. The step is one radius outside the overrun line, away from the footprint. With a radius, rows spaced wider than the tool diameter turn on arcs too.
- **Slot** gets `blend_turns` and `blend_radius`. Each row-end corner of the serpentine pass turns on one tangent arc. No radius is the tool radius. The new module is `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_turns.rs`.

The parameter door (`sane.rs`) refuses a radius below 0.01 mm on the three kinds. The generators refuse a radius larger than the tool radius, with the text of `corner_arc_radius`. The project file writes the keys only when they are set. The cache digest reads the radius only when the option is on.

The operation pages show the radius rows when the option is on. The Face page names its default "Arc radius = half the row spacing".

MCP: `edit_operation` sets the two fields through `EditOperationParams`. No new command and no new tool are necessary.

The type is `feat`, because the change adds parameters. The task template gave `fix`.

## Cause

The fix for #1733 gave the radius to the three pocket kinds only. Face and 2D Contour had the option without a radius. Slot did not have the option.

## Which corners turn, and why no arc cuts past the wall

- 2D Contour: only a corner that turns toward the air gets an arc. This is the law of `fillet.rs`, and it did not change. A corner that turns toward the part stays sharp, and the notes name it. A convex outside corner is such a corner, so an arc cannot leave material there.
- Face: each point of a turn is on or outside the overrun line, one tool radius from the footprint. The turn reaches one radius past that line at most.
- Slot: the pass is in the cutter-center stadium, which is convex. A fillet is inside the triangle of its corner and its two tangent points, and that triangle is inside the stadium. `fillet_corners` proves each triangle again and keeps a corner sharp if it cannot prove it. An arc leaves corner rest at the round end of the slot. The note states the largest rest.

### Review fix: the Face radius bound

`corner_turn` in `blend.rs` gave the semicircle when half the row spacing was less than 0.005 mm past the radius. That semicircle is larger than the radius. Now:

- If half the spacing is not more than the radius (1e-9 mm float margin), the turn is the semicircle, as before. Its radius is not larger than the requested radius.
- If half the spacing is more than the radius by 0.005 mm or less, the turn uses two corner arcs. Their radius is half the spacing minus 0.005 mm, which is less than the requested radius. The straight step stays 0.01 mm.
- If that radius is below 0.01 mm, the turn stays sharp. The status line counts it as the `Tiny` refusal ("row spacing below the 0.020 mm arc resolution").

Pins: `crates/motion/tests/arc_turn_kinds.rs::a_face_turn_never_exceeds_the_radius_when_the_straight_step_is_short` (the reviewer's 60 x 10.025 mm case and three other spacings), and the unit test `blend::law::a_short_step_never_turns_on_an_arc_larger_than_the_radius`.

### Review fix: the exhaustive test literals

The latest review found missing required fields in nine exhaustive test literals from main. The branch now includes a merge of upstream main `aa4c785dbd53715f1d811524dc99c688b9380cba`.

- Face literals have `blend_radius: None` in `chamfer_partly_bevelled`, `first_traverse`, `first_traverse_table`, `setup_move_order`, `stock_copy_hole`, `vouch_fidelity` and `vouch_fidelity_mcp`.
- Slot literals have `blend_turns: false` and `blend_radius: None` in `tilt_basis0_edited_file` and `tilt_stock_cap`.
- Current main adds the same missing Face default in `first_traverse_mill_turn` and `model_fidelity_wide`. These literals have `blend_radius: None` too.

- Current main also adds a Contour literal and a Slot literal in `crates/motion/tests/equal_steps.rs`. The Contour literal has `blend_radius: None`. The Slot literal has `blend_turns: false` and `blend_radius: None`.

- The test helper in `crates/app/src/operation/first_traverse.rs` also has `blend_radius: None`. Its pin is `operation::first_traverse::tests::a_mill_turn_judges_its_milling_kinds_in_the_mill_order`.

- The Contour literal in `crates/app/tests/equal_steps.rs` has `blend_radius: None`. Its pin is `equal_steps::edit_sets_equal_steps_and_undo_restores_the_remainder_ladder`.

The fix adds 18 default-field lines in fourteen files. All changed literals are in tests. It changes no runtime source logic.

Runtime pins: eleven app suites passed 47 tests. Motion `equal_steps` passed 13 tests. The app first-traverse unit pin passed one test. App `equal_steps` passed six tests.

Mutation: removing the added defaults gave compiler error `E0063` in the affected literals. Restoring the defaults made all fourteen affected suites compile and pass.

Final head: `4adba68fd814090bac6f28bc2acd4e0eb4675200`

Quick gate: 761 steps passed on final head `4adba68fd814090bac6f28bc2acd4e0eb4675200`, against upstream main `aa4c785dbd53715f1d811524dc99c688b9380cba`. The first run passed all 123 motion steps. The app build then stopped on a stale local `camcraft_kernel` artifact (`E0463`) after the check profile changed. After rebuilding that local artifact, `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only app --only ui` passed all 638 selected steps, with 0 failed, in 38.6 minutes. These two runs cover the quick plan: 7,028 tests passed, 0 failed and 115 ignored. No source change was needed for the artifact failure.

Heavy lanes: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed on final head `4adba68fd814090bac6f28bc2acd4e0eb4675200`: 237 steps, 0 failed, in 44.3 minutes. The reached motion and app heavy lanes ran. The lanes ran 100 passing tests and six expected failures: three for #1950 and three for #2849. There were 0 unexpected failures. Motion had 38 steps and 57 passing tests. App had 198 steps and 43 passing tests. The shared build was one step.

The results above are for the old head `4adba68fd`. The results for the current head are in the next section.

### Review fix: the Slot conflict with main (#2906 wall lap)

The branch now includes a merge of upstream main `a2c35e0eb`. Merge commit `22f3ffb98` resolves one conflict in `slot()` in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slots.rs`. The two behaviors stay:

- The #1759 arc turns round the serpentine rows only. `rows` is a copy of the pass before the lap points join it.
- The #2906 wall lap follows the rows in the same walk. The new helper `slot_turns::with_lap` puts the rounded walk (or the straight rows, when nothing rounds) first, then the lap.
- A fillet does not move the end of a walk. Thus the rounded rows end on the tangent point where the lap starts.

Commit `d80eccfab` updates the app pin: the sharp Slot pass now has the lap's cap arcs.

Pins:

- `crates/motion/tests/slot_round_ends.rs::wide_slot_with_arc_turns_still_cuts_its_round_ends` (new). With arc turns on, climb and conventional, 10 mm and 20 mm wide: no crossing, no center outside the stadium, and no more than 0.01 mm left on the wall.
- `crates/motion/tests/arc_turn_kinds.rs::slot_row_ends_turn_on_tangent_arcs_of_the_given_radius`. The sharp pass has only cap arcs, and the rounded pass keeps the same count of lap arcs.
- `crates/app/tests/arc_turn_kinds.rs::generation_cuts_the_face_and_the_slot_turns_at_the_radius_asked`. Lap arcs and turn arcs are counted apart. The lap is the same with arc turns off and on.

Mutation: `with_lap` returned the rounded walk without the lap. All three pins went red. The round-ends pin gave "1.290 mm left on the wall". The app pin gave "the arc turns lost the wall lap". After the restore, all three passed.

Final head: `d80eccfab07832fc66bfd4368d6579402eae492c`.

## Goldens moved

None. `git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` is empty. The default output of each kind did not change.

## Size of the diff

The diff touches about 290 files. Most hunks are one line: an exhaustive `OpParams::Face`, `OpParams::Contour`, `OpParams::Slot`, `FaceParams`, `ContourParams` or `SlotParams` literal gets `blend_radius: None` (and `blend_turns: false` for Slot). The logic is in these files:

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/blend.rs`, `face.rs`, `slots.rs`, `slot_turns.rs` (new), `contour_params.rs`, `tab_bridge.rs`
- `crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs`, `types/sane.rs`, `generate.rs`, `params.rs`, `params/mill2d.rs`
- `crates/app/src/project/params.rs`, `params_impl.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/kind_editors.rs`, `mill2d_page.rs`, `mill2d_more_page.rs`

## Not exercised

- No posted G-code test for the new Face corner arcs or the Slot arcs. The post reads them as the same G2/G3 moves that the semicircle and the pocket arcs give.
- No UI test clicks the new radius rows. They use `arc_turn_rows`, the rows of the pocket kinds. No snapshot PNG changed.
- 2D Contour generation with a radius ran through the app only as a refusal (a radius past the tool radius). The arcs at the radius are pinned in the motion crate.
- A Slot with arc turns and a Ramp or Helix entry, or keep-down links, has no test of its own. The fillet does not move the start or the end of the pass.
- A Contour with tabs and a radius has no test of its own. The tab code calls the same `keep_cut`.
- The compile cache (sccache) did not answer on this machine during the work. The builds ran without it (`CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`, no `RUSTC_WRAPPER`). This does not change the results.

## Overlaps

- #2716 (2D Contour on DXF sketches) touches the same files, different functions. It does not change the `blend_*` fields or the Contour literals. Whichever merges second refreshes.
- #2714 (Slot Undercut) touches the same files, different functions. It adds its own kind and does not change `OpParams::Slot`. Whichever merges second refreshes.
- #2678 touches `generate.rs` and `machining2d/mod.rs`, different functions.

Each new exhaustive literal of the six types in another open PR needs the new fields after this PR merges.

Decision record: `docs/decisions/1759-arc-turn-radius.md`.
